script: Chapter 10. Productivity System. Protect deep work by blocking time in your calendar. Keep tasks on a board and clients in a sheet. Review your week every Friday. Use Google Calendar, Trello or Notion, a Google Sheets client list, and Looker Studio for reports. Use AI to save time, but check every fact, and never paste client passwords or private data into a public tool.
glossary: productivity system, time blocking, Trello, Google Calendar, CRM
